A '''steel claymore''' is a [[claymore]] of the [[Steel equipment|steel]] tier, a two-handed sword that can also block like a shield. It is made by smithing an [[iron sword]] with [[steel alloy]] and a [[smithing upgrade template]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot; without one, the same iron sword and alloy make a [[steel sword]]. Enchantments on the base item carry over.

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Steel Claymore|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Steel Claymore|attackspeed}} and adds 2 attack knockback. It has {{Value|Steel Claymore|durability}} durability, half that of the other steel weapons.

=== Blocking ===
Holding the use button raises the claymore like a shield. It blocks 70% of melee damage and 60% of arrow and mob projectile damage, and loses durability equal to a quarter of the damage it blocks. An axe disables it for twice as long as a shield.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_claymore.json}}</ref> The [[adamant claymore]] blocks more.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
